chapters.title: Your copilot is starved of context
Layer 1: system context that doesn't drift

takeaways: Most Power Platform AI failures come from missing context, not model limits, so design four layers: system, retrieval, tools and policies.
Ground the agent in a Dataverse schema index first, add structured documents second, and apply security trimming and field-level filters to cut hallucinations, latency and cost.
Expose actions only as least-privilege Power Automate flows with strict input schemas, and enforce DLP, sensitivity labels, conditional access and a kill switch per environment.
hook: Copilot Studio agents that invent fields and behave differently in each environment are usually starved of context, not too dumb. This episode gives Power Platform makers and architects a four-layer context engineering pattern, from system message and Dataverse-first retrieval to governed Power Automate tools and DLP policies, with before-and-after metrics.
